Settings.Name: Preset
Settings.Description: Fast preset for overall tuning. Advanced Mode exposes the full control set, and manual edits to preset-owned advanced settings switch this to CUSTOM.

Settings.Name: Advanced Mode
Settings.Description: Shows the full tuning controls. Presets remain the simple entry point; manual edits to preset-owned advanced settings switch Preset to CUSTOM.

Settings.Name: Custom Base Preset
Settings.Description: Base preset used for CUSTOM tuning after advanced preset-owned settings are edited.

Settings.Name: Combat Extender Compatibility
Settings.Description: Use lighter tier/champion scaling when Combat Extender (or similar scaling mods) is active. Prevents double-stacking difficulty.

Settings.Name: Ambush Intensity
Settings.Description: Multiplier applied to point budget. Advanced Mode only; when Advanced Mode is OFF, Preset values are authoritative.

Settings.Name: Scale With Party Size
Settings.Description: Scales ambush point budget based on party size (fewer members = lighter ambushes, more = heavier). Always ON unless Advanced Mode is enabled - toggle only takes effect in Advanced Mode.

Settings.Name: Strict Progression Gates
Settings.Description: Enforces min/max party-level gates for ambush templates. Advanced Mode only; this is a global guardrail and is not preset-owned.

Settings.Name: Use Composition Guards
Settings.Description: Applies per-ambush power-class caps to prevent too many heavy units at once. Advanced Mode only; this is a global guardrail and is not preset-owned.

Settings.Name: Scaling Profile
Settings.Description: Choose the progression track used for scaling. Extended 13-20 is for level-cap mods; Vanilla 1-12 is for default BG3 progression.

Settings.Name: Enable Reputation System
Settings.Description: Tracks creature-type reputation and can escalate to champions over time.

Settings.Name: Decay Rate
Settings.Description: How fast negative reputation decays toward 0 on periodic decay ticks while out of combat.

Settings.Name: Allow Ambush Checks In Vulnerable Moments
Settings.Description: Allows hunters to strike during brief and extended respites.

Settings.Name: Enable Time-In-Danger Pressure
Settings.Description: Lets exposure in dangerous areas build extra ambush pressure over time, including passive travel danger checks. Turning this OFF clears stored time-in-danger buildup.

Settings.Name: Respect Safety Checks
Settings.Description: Prevents ambushes in unsafe states (dialog/cinematics/camp restrictions). Recommended ON.

Settings.Name: Allow Camp Ambushes
Settings.Description: If enabled, ambushes may occur in camp/safe zones. Recommended OFF for a vanilla feel.

Settings.Name: Enable Cooldown
Settings.Description: Adds a per-player cooldown between ambushes. Advanced Mode only; Preset controls this when Advanced Mode is OFF.

Settings.Name: Cooldown (Minutes)
Settings.Description: Cooldown duration in minutes. Advanced Mode only; Preset controls this when Advanced Mode is OFF.

Settings.Name: Enable Ambush System
Settings.Description: Master toggle for the ambush and retaliation system.

Settings.Name: Use Vanilla Enemy Pool
Settings.Description: Use the built-in vanilla enemy list. Turn OFF only if an external provider or compatibility patch is installed; otherwise ambushes may have no valid enemy pool.

Settings.Name: Apply Surprise on Ambush
Settings.Description: Runs the ambush surprise check for eligible party members when combat starts. Party members that pass the Perception check or have immunity effects are not surprised.

Settings.Name: Arrival Cue Policy
Settings.Description: Controls ambient arrival cues for spawned ambushers. Balanced uses the tier chance table. Always On forces cue attempts for visibility. Off disables extra arrival cues and keeps only the baseline spawn VFX fallback.

Settings.Name: Spawn Placement Mode
Settings.Description: Controls how ambushers pick spawn locations. Create OOS Only is the default and only uses CreateOutOfSight. Auto uses out-of-sight placement for the anchor and spread placement for support spawns when possible. Find Valid Only skips CreateOutOfSight.

Settings.Name: Enable Escapes
Settings.Description: Allows non-champion ambushers to attempt fleeing after prolonged combat. Detailed escape chance/timing is preset-owned in normal play.

Settings.Name: Debug Logging
Settings.Description: Adds verbose Hunted diagnostics to Script Extender logs. Enable when testing or reporting bugs.

Settings.Name: Ambush XP (%)
Settings.Description: Ambush XP as a percent of normal enemy XP. Advanced Mode only; when Advanced Mode is OFF, Preset values are authoritative.

Settings.Name: Disable Generated Ambush Loot
Settings.Description: If enabled, generated ambush loot is cleared while corpses should remain interactable. This is an optional economy-cleanup mode; all presets allow ambush loot by default.

Settings.Name: Allow Champion Loot
Settings.Description: If enabled, champions can keep loot even when generated ambush loot is disabled. This only matters when Disable Generated Ambush Loot is enabled.
